<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant peak with a small M+1 peak (~5.6 % of the base) and an even smaller M+2 peak (~0.5 %). This pattern matches the natural isotopic distribution of carbon (12C ≈ 98.9 %, 13C ≈ 1.1 %). No other common element exhibits a characteristic M+2 intensity of this magnitude (e.g., Cl, Br, S), so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
